item.title: CVE-2026-98432 — Linux Kernel IPv4 TCP Use-After-Free (SYN Retransmission and Request-Migration Race)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — network · CVE-2026-98432. Status: PoC. Affects: Linux kernel — IPv4 TCP stack (tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock(), inet_sock_destruct(), tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor(), ip_options_build()); IPv6 request-socket migration has a related ipv6_opt issue handled separately. Tags: UAF, CWE-416, use-after-free, Linux-kernel, TCP, IPv4, SYN, race-condition, MPTCP, request-migration.
